personality_one_liner: A pristine, calm, and high-trust educational ecosystem pairing iOS-native clarity with warm botanical tones and effortless cross-role navigation.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical rhythm with structured padding and clear component grouping.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky navigation bars and search headers
Apply translucent tinted base over hero cards
dont's: Do not blur form fields or dense text areas
Never stack multiple heavy blur layers

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Mobile OTP authentication with Truecaller-first verification and role selection.

states.loading: Centered verification spinner with secure token status
states.empty: Phone number entry prompt with country code selector
states.error: Inline OTP error message with resend countdown timer

screens.layout: Clean centered vertical stack with generous whitespace, botanical brand emblem, and prominent OTP input boxes.

screens.name: StudentDiscovery
screens.purpose: Explore top-rated institutes, courses, batches, and live scholarship offers.

states.loading: Shimmer skeleton cards for institute grids and featured courses
states.empty: Empty state illustration with filter reset and search suggestions
states.error: Friendly retry banner with offline cache indicator

screens.layout: Top sticky search header with category pill filters, featured hero banner carousel, and vertical course/institute discovery cards.

screens.name: InstituteDashboard
screens.purpose: Merchant and institute hub for managing courses, batches, enrollments, and revenue stats.

states.loading: Skeleton financial widgets and batch list loaders
states.empty: Onboarding prompt to publish first institute course or batch
states.error: Error retry card for merchant metrics sync

screens.layout: Modular metric cards at top, quick action grid for batch creation, and scrollable list of active enrollments.

screens.name: AdminOversight
screens.purpose: System-wide governance, dispute resolution, refund processing, and audit logs.

states.loading: Activity log skeleton loader and metric counter placeholders
states.empty: All caught up state with zero pending moderation flags
states.error: Server sync error alert with manual refresh trigger

screens.layout: Segmented tab bar for Users, Institutes, Refunds, and Audit Logs with quick-action approval rows.

screens.name: ProfileSettings
screens.purpose: Student profile completion, language preferences, favorites, and activity history.

states.loading: Profile header skeleton with badge placeholders
states.empty: Prompt to complete academic profile for personalized recommendations
states.error: Failed to save profile changes alert

screens.layout: Scrollable form with avatar header, multi-language selector, notification toggles, and saved favorites list.

hero_banner.alt: Modern campus learning hall with natural lighting

institute_logo_1.alt: Apex Institute of Technology logo mark

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all navigation flows preserve exact existing backend endpoints and storage utilities in /app/frontend/src/utils/storage.tsx. Implement bottom tab navigation for students and role-switchers for merchants/admins. Follow iOS-native clean design rules with 0.5pt/1pt borders and botanical color tokens.
